title: Slow-Cooker Sausage Casserole
subtitle: Pork sausages in a rich tomato and pepper sauce
excerpt: Pork sausages cooked in a slow cooker with peppers, onions, and tinned tomatoes in a paprika-spiced sauce. A weeknight family dinner that needs almost no attention.

recipe.sourceNotes: Sausage casserole is one of the most widely made slow-cooker dishes in British households. The sausages can go in raw or browned first; browning first takes 5 minutes and gives a better colour but is not essential for the flavour of the finished casserole. Smoked paprika and Worcestershire sauce are the signature seasonings. Serve with mashed potato or crusty bread to soak up the sauce.

content.text: Brown the sausages in a hot frying pan before adding them to the slow cooker: they turn pale and grey-looking if added raw and never recover the colour. A 5-minute brown makes a significant visual difference. The sauce reduces and deepens over the 6 hours of cooking.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan. Brown the sausages all over for 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer to the slow cooker.

Add the onion, pepper, garlic, tinned tomatoes, tomato puree, smoked paprika, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, and thyme to the slow cooker. Stir briefly around the sausages. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook on LOW for 6 hours or HIGH for 3 to 4 hours. Remove the bay leaves and thyme stalks. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Serve with mashed potato or crusty bread.
